newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat finds support at A$180.00 a tonne.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat finds support at A$180.00 a tonne.

text.p: Wheat futures found support on the Sydney Futures Exchange (SFE) on Tuesday with the market focus January contract edging ahead.

The Australian Wheat Board's announcement of A$10 a tonne pool price cuts and its increase in its 1996/97 crop estimate to 19 million tonnes failed to move SFE wheat futures with the changes already factored into prices, traders said.
January 1997, the only contract to trade, rose by A$1 to A$180.00 a tonne in four trades on the SFE on Tuesday.
Despite present support the market still looked bearish, Matt Kirk of McIntosh Futures Ltd said.
